definition: a job you are ordered to do
description: In an army camp with olive canvas tents on red earth, a young woman in a navy work uniform salutes with a glum, pouting face while a young man in the same uniform hands her a potato peeler and one potato falls into a sack. She takes the peeler with a sigh, then crouches down beside several huge open sacks full of potatoes and picks one up, while he stands and watches. Behind them are a large steel cooking pot on a stand, a metal bucket and a stone water trough, with pine trees and more tents behind.

en.question: What is the man handing her?

es.answer: Le está dando un pelador de patatas.
es.question: ¿Qué le está dando el hombre?

fr.answer: Il lui tend un éplucheur à pommes de terre.
fr.question: Que lui tend l'homme ?
